save.text: MATT announced no main-story Critical Role next week due to San Diego Comic-Con and mentioned panel times at PetCo Park; panel will be filmed and streamed later. (turns 6-8,12)
Next subscriber giveaway thresholds: already at 4,200 (won by LL1973); next at 4,250 and then every +50 subs a PHB+cast photo will be given. (turns 0,1,2)
Matt and Marisha will be out of town in New Zealand the week after Comic-Con, causing ~two-week break from main-story; remaining available cast will play other games during that period. (turn 12)
Intro video malfunction noted; cast decided to skip it and jump into game. (turns 75,110-112,124)
Sam joined mid-start; confirmed by Matt and Sam. (turns 132-138)

Recap of current story state: Vox Machina has Horn of Orcus, heading to Vasselheim on a skyship crossing Ozmit Sea; attacked by wyvern/griffin bandits earlier; skyship still airborne. (turns 130-139,145-146)
Halfling mage passenger (saved by party) is imprisoned in ship's anti-magic brig by Captain Damon; captain reluctant to employ her due to prior attack. (turns 151-156,161)
Percy is reading; next few days pass uneventfully while skyship continues over Ozmit Sea; party rested and spells recovered. (turns 167,224,227)

Grog attempted magical beard growth succeeded minimally (38%); crew braided and decorated sparse translucent stubble; Liam secretly glued rope goatee onto Grog while he slept. Goliath facial hair growth is atypical and potentially risky. (turns 180-186,196-204,230-236)
Grog woke to a dark brown, well-braided 3–4" goatee braid and is proud of it. (turn 238)
Mid-sixth day of travel weather turned cold and overcast; Nature check (Marisha) 20: clouds forming slowly, likely natural colder weather for northern continent. (turns 245,250-251)
Tiberius (Orion) negotiated trade: Scanlan (Sam) agreed to trade his circlet for Tiberius's Ioun Stone after demonstration/argument. (turns 258-266,303-312,307)
Orion/Ioun Stone orbit confirmed; holds up to three leveled spells (can store three level spells), no slot expenditure. Party reacts positively. (turns 317-336,325)
Temperature dropped; light snow began to fall over skyship. (turn 350)

Keyleth (Marisha) described Fire Ashari in Vasselheim/Pyrah: sister tribe to Air Ashari; Ashari protect planar bleed points; Keyleth must undertake Aramente to prove leadership; last Aramente participant from tribe did not return. Party offered to accompany after Horn is handled. (turns 356,366,372,400-402)

Keyleth's mother revealed to be the person Marisha referenced; Keyleth last saw her at age ~5-6 and is next in line. Party intends to visit tribe when in region; cast supportive. (turns 408-445,451-456)

Land sighted: continent Othanzia with Vesper Timberland forest, snowy peaks, and a central fortified mountain-city ~20–30 miles inland with layered walls and dragon-headed ballistae. Kima (NPC) greeting noted. (turns 457,459,463,466,473)
Party descending toward city; city appears heavily fortified with mixed-age walls (some recent, some ancient) and signs of defensive preparations for sieges. (turns 473-476)
City of Vasselheim approached; ship docks on a flattened mill-top platform with haphazard crane; crew preparing ropes and lowering Trinket. (turns 477,543)
Kima appears anxious about entering city; offers to answer questions and mentions escorts will guide party. (turns 543,546-551)
Scanlan stores a 3rd-level Lightning Bolt in the Ioun Stone; stone glows greenish-blue though it is white. (turns 526-538)
Kima last served with her Order 'properly' eight years ago; she appears nervous about reunion. (turns 557-565,569-576)
Scalebearer Yonn is present; bald elderly man in silver/blue robes, appears dedicated and not deceptive per Insight (Liam 13, Ashley 15). (turns 568-571,596-600)

Platinum Sanctuary is ~25-minute walk from docking platform; escorts (including Yonn and Scalebearers) will guide party; few in city know of the Horn—only Kima, the travelers, and Highbearer Vord. (turns 585-589,606-613)
Vasselheim described as 'Dawn City', cradle of faith; many visible holy symbols (Arathis, Avandra, Melora, Bahamut); Sarenrae notably absent. (turns 635-641,648-650)
Scalebearer Yonn leads party into city; party warned about openly altering appearance (Alter Self) in public. (turns 661,656-659)

Party plans stealth/overwatch approach while moving from docking platform: Vex and Percy rooftop, Scanlan blending in, Trinket/others accompany; Stealth rolls: Scanlan 23, Vex rolled a 1. (turns 665-705,694,701)
Vasselheim is an ancient, harsh 'Dawn City' and holy center; arcane magic is considered profane/public use restricted. (turn 717)

Platinum Sanctuary: large ancient fortress built into mountain with Draconic inscriptions; Bahamut symbol on massive doors; three later-added ivory/silver spires visible; doors open for party. (turns 745,751,758)
Bastions: city militia volunteers make up ~25% of populace; wear patchwork armor and patrol extensively. (turn 769-774)
Dense forest around city shows large, fast-moving, multi-serpentine creature(s) (likely hydra-like); ballistae fired and creature moved away—appears to be a common occurrence. (turns 774,809-816,819)

Keyleth (as eagle) saw moving trees ~1/4 mile away and attempted to scout; temple doors closed then she re-entered via an arrow-slit, confronted by a Platinum Dragon guard and asked to make a Persuasion check. (turns 776,803-846)
Dense forest around city shows large, fast-moving, multi-serpentine creature(s); ballistae fired and creature moved away—appears common. (turns 774,809-816,819)
Kima intervened when Keyleth was being cuffed; she declared Keyleth 'with me' and Scalebearers quickly removed cuffs and backed off. (turns 882-894)
Platinum Sanctuary/chamber interior: plain, ancient stone fortress humming with strong divine energy (not Pike's usual type); Pike is noticeably affected. (turns 910-931)

Platinum Sanctuary central chamber: dome ~80 ft, creation fresco showing Bahamut vs five-headed chromatic dragon (Tiamat). Highbearer Vord greets party; recognizes Horn of Orcus when Scalebearers present container — it pulses then vanishes into divine light and Vord confirms it's one of the Horns of Orcus and must be sealed. (turn 934-973)

Platinum Sanctuary central chamber: dome ~80 ft, creation fresco showing Bahamut vs five-headed chromatic dragon (Tiamat). Highbearer Vord greeted party; Horn of Orcus pulsed then vanished into divine light; Vord confirmed it's a Horn of Orcus and must be sealed. Vord explained Star of Exaltation (Bahamut's tear crystal) was lost/destroyed ~300 years ago during a siege and the chamber has been prepared to seal the Horn; a Scalebearer (Yonn) was tasked to ready lower chambers but fled after subterranean spider infestation and triggered some vault defenses. Scalebearers will accompany party into vault and bring the Horn; temple claims strong divine/alert defenses if the vault is fully triggered. (turns 934-973,979-1026,1029-1031)
Kima intervened when Keyleth was being cuffed; she declared Keyleth 'with me' and Scalebearers quickly removed cuffs and backed off. Kima spat toward Yonn after he fled. (turns 882-894,984)

Scalebearer Yonn present; was assigned to prepare Hall of the Exalt lower chambers but fled upon finding subterranean spider infestation and initiating some defenses; he exited room sheepishly when called out. Temple defends his long service despite his failing. (turns 568-571,596-600,979-987,991-996)

Platinum Sanctuary central chamber: dome ~80 ft, creation fresco showing Bahamut vs five-headed chromatic dragon (Tiamat). Highbearer Vord greets party; recognizes Horn of Orcus when Scalebearers present container — it pulses then vanishes into divine light and Vord confirms it's one of the Horns of Orcus and must be sealed. Party offered 3000 gp total to seal horn; Kima objects to taking money; party intends to take payment for alms. (turns 934-973,1101-1127,1124-1126)
Primeval Awareness (Keyleth) used to scan 6-mile radius around city; result: no dragons detected. (turn 1050-1052)
Party escorted to vault/storage basement by Kima to seal Horn; temple descends into mountain through multiple layers into a musty, dank storage area. (turns 1130-1140)
Kima placed her holy symbol into a recess, dispelling a wood illusion and revealing a stone doorway leading to a staircase; she admitted she hasn't been within the vault. (turns 1144-1146)

Descending stair leads to 50x50 room with low light and persistent white mist emitted from mouths of two carved dragon pillars; pillars' bases have slight gaps suggesting they pivot; mist refills quickly and Gust of Wind clears center briefly. (turns 1160-1176,1187-1190,1171-1174)
Group considered traps and rolled Perception: Vax 19, Vex 25; no visible traps found on stairway. (turns 1156-1160,1181-1186)

During dash through mist barrier: Keyleth, Scanlan, Tiberius, Pike triggered concealed dragon-mouth flames when mist breached; Dex saves: Vax and Tiberius succeeded (no damage), Orion half, Scanlan/Keyleth/Pike took 24 fire. Keyleth used a second spell slot to clear mist and guided open path; Scalebearers moved with party. (turns 1215-1309)

During dash through mist barrier: Keyleth, Scanlan, Tiberius, Pike triggered concealed dragon-mouth flames when mist breached; Dex saves: Vax and Tiberius succeeded (no damage), Orion half, Scanlan/Keyleth/Pike took 24 fire. Keyleth used a second spell slot to clear mist and guided open path; Scalebearers moved with party. (turns 1215-1309)

Current chamber beyond mist: circular room with multiple floor circles/pistons that rise to ceiling and room rotates; triggered when Vax touched a circle. Vax used Boots of Haste, took 40 crushing damage from piston and continued across with acrobatics success. (turns 1322-1385)
Room beyond features a wide 20-foot staircase descending opposite side; no door. Light arrow revealed layout. Perception/stealth: Vex perception 16, Liam (Vax) 29. (turns 1326-1341)

During dash through mist barrier: Keyleth, Scanlan, Tiberius, Pike triggered concealed dragon-mouth flames when mist breached; Dex saves: Vax and Tiberius succeeded (no damage), Orion half, Scanlan/Keyleth/Pike took 24 fire. Keyleth used a second spell slot to clear mist and guided open path; Scalebearers moved with party. (turns 1215-1309)
Room is a rotating grinding mill with slamming central pillars; a quarter-sized hole in ceiling is visible only intermittently when a pillar retracts. (turns 1390-1406)
Vex (Laura) made a precise ricochet-style arrow attack (total 35 with inspiration) into the intermittently visible hole; shot timed between piston slams. (turns 1469-1472)

During pillar event: an arrow ricocheted into a small slit, caused splintering metal and grinding; party proceeded across; short rest initiated. Guests Orion and Taylor introduced; charity/GameChanger segment begins. (turns 1479-1540,1550-1555)

Charity/GameChanger segment: Taylor (GameChanger founder) described mission—hospital visits, gaming packages, scholarships; donation link www.gamechangercharity.org; donations > $1 get Deus Ex director's cut. Critical Role redirected donations tonight to GameChanger; 826LA portion also redirected. (turns 1556-1611)
